question: Should this draft be rebased narrowly onto current main's adapter contracts, or folded into a broader tool-snapshot hardening branch before this branch is closed?
rationale: The useful guard is clear, but the live PR is a protected maintainer draft with a dirty conflict and a compatibility-sensitive stale body; automation cannot choose whether to preserve this branch or fold the work into a broader maintainer-owned stack.

options.title: Rebase narrowly around current contracts
options.body: Apply the safe descriptor readers to current main and keep hideFromChannelProgress, prepareArguments, executionMode, structured replay trust, before-hook prepare/finalize, and blocked-result context intact.

options.title: Fold into a broader hardening branch
options.body: Close this branch only after a clean replacement PR preserves the optional-field fallback and required-field skip behavior for the core adapter path.

recommendation.title: Rebase narrowly around current contracts
recommendation.body: Apply the safe descriptor readers to current main and keep hideFromChannelProgress, prepareArguments, executionMode, structured replay trust, before-hook prepare/finalize, and blocked-result context intact.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this branch and the merged related Codex descriptor quarantine, making them the best available owner for the rebase-or-fold decision.
